name: Admin Send Branded Email (Negotiating)
description: Admin sends a branded marketing email from the Correos tab of a proposal in negotiating/accepted/rejected status. Composer with draggable sections (per-section Markdown toggle), file attachments, server-rendered preview of the real branded template (POST /api/emails/preview/ with proposal_id, sandboxed iframe), paginated history. Endpoints: POST /api/proposals/:id/branded-email/send/, GET /api/proposals/:id/branded-email/defaults/, GET /api/proposals/:id/branded-email/history/.
